towns.name: Ahurenga
towns.summary: Ahurenga (47.0N 90.3W) is the capital of the Hea Tumeroks of Marae Lassel, led by Hea Arantah, a xuta that abandoned Aun tradition to serve the Virindi ('Atual Arutoa') and had their bodies altered toward human form. It is a small reed-ringed island village in the coastal swamp of the Northern Ahurenga Plains, barely 2 m above the sea, with 10-14 m swamp ferns everywhere and open sea to the north-west. At its heart stands a broken four-storey stone spire (the acpedia 'broken Advocate Spire') crowned by a purple Virindi energy funnel and blue light halos, its south stair lit by two torches; around it are Hea huts and an octagonal tower, three carved totem poles around a smouldering brazier, a campfire ring with big flame and blue-flame braziers, an open hall by the water and the Town Network portal. There is no Life Stone. (The telepoi lands in the water 270 m south-east of the village; all shots are within 2 landblocks.)
